title: Dog Walker
text: When someone spins 9, they pay you 20K.

title: Zoo Keeper
text: Landing on Ram wins the game.

title: Bus Driver
text: You may own two cars. Theft takes only one.

title: Janitor
text: Night School is free. A spouse you pass is removed.

title: Aaron
text: Each child is +1 speed and 100K when they arrive.

title: Baby Sitter
text: Pass a car with children: 80K per child from the owner.

title: Bee Keeper
text: A spin of 3 is a Snake Return. The bank pays you 1,000K.

title: Police Officer
text: Passing a car sends it to jail.

title: Assassin
text: A spin of 2 is Death Return. A Singer loses their voice first.

title: Draymond Green
text: A spin of 3: the spinner pays you 200K.

title: Lifeguard
text: When someone dies, you take the same death.

title: Pirate
text: Payday adds 150K. Bank charges pay you instead.

title: Thief
text: A spin of 4 steals 200K from the spinner.

title: Singer
text: The first Assassin hit silences you. The second restores your voice.

title: YouTuber
text: On taking the job, spin. Black pays 500K once.

title: Race Car Driver
text: Double speed. A raw 9 or 10 is Death Return.

title: Carpenter
text: A spin of 5 pays 200K. You ignore the first star cost.
